title: Severe water leakage and ceiling dampness in Block B 3rd Floor
description: Room 312 to 316 in Boys Hostel Block B have persistent water seepage from the terrace during rains. Plaster is peeling off and poses an electrical hazard near the power sockets.

timeline.note: Grievance registered. AI flagged critical electrical risk.
Estate maintenance supervisor inspected site. Waterproofing requisition raised.

title: Undercooked rice and substandard hygiene in North Campus Mess
description: The lunch served on Tuesday had partially raw rice and unwashed spinach in dal. Multiple students experienced stomach distress. Water dispenser filters also appear overdue for replacement.

timeline.note: Submitted via student portal. Categorized under Food Safety.
Notice issued to catering contractor. Water sample sent for lab test.

title: Semester 5 Data Structures re-evaluation marks missing on ERP
description: Over 25 students applied for re-evaluation for CS-301 before the September 15 deadline. The ERP portal still shows old grades, impacting internship eligibility verification.

timeline.note: Grievance received and routed to COE office.
Discrepancy identified in database sync batch.
Updated grade sheets uploaded to ERP portal and verified by students.

title: Campus Shuttle Route #4 skipped 8:15 AM schedule repeatedly
description: Bus #4 from Metro Station to South Gate has failed to arrive at 8:15 AM for three consecutive days, leading to students receiving late attendance penalties for 9 AM lab sessions.
location: City Metro to South Campus Gate

timeline.note: Transport grievance filed with bus log reference.
Route schedule audited; driver reassigned and backup coach scheduled.
GPS tracking enabled on Route #4; backup bus operated on time.

title: Damaged fume hood and faulty ventilation in Chemistry Lab 2
description: The exhaust blower in organic synthesis Lab 204 produces a grinding noise and fails to pull fumes out during esterification experiments. Strong chemical odor lingers inside.

timeline.note: AI identified hazardous chemical environment keyword match.
Lab temporarily sealed for volatile experiments. Technician dispatched.

title: Wi-Fi dead zone on Central Library 2nd Floor reading section
description: Signal drops completely near reference racks 12 to 24. Students cannot access IEEE Xplore and digital journal databases while studying for semester projects.

timeline.note: Auto-assigned to IT network operations for access point signal survey.

title: Broken elevator button panel and entrapment risk in Girls Hostel 3
description: The 2nd floor door sensor on Elevator B jams halfway. Yesterday evening the cabin jerked between floors for nearly 10 minutes before releasing.

timeline.note: Critical urgency assigned by AI safety detection.
Lift B turned off for public safety. Otis engineers contracted for sensor replacement.

title: Praise for extended library hours during mid-term examination week
description: The 24/7 opening of the air-conditioned study hall helped our research groups tremendously. Requesting this to be made standard during finals as well.

timeline.note: Constructive feedback and operational extension proposal recorded.
Discussed in Dean Academics operational meeting.
Formal circular issued making 24-hr study hall access standard for all exam periods.

title: Insufficient streetlights along East Campus sports complex walkway
description: The path connecting girls hostel block to the sports arena is pitch dark after 7 PM due to three burnt out solar streetlamps, creating serious safety concerns.

timeline.note: High priority incident created. Security guards alerted for evening patrols.

title: Broken microscopes in Microbiology UG Laboratory 101
description: Four out of ten binocular microscopes have scratched objective lenses (40x and 100x oil immersion), preventing proper identification of gram-stained specimens.

timeline.note: Requisition forwarded to Head of Biological Sciences.
Optical servicing vendor inspected damaged lenses.
Lenses replaced and calibrated with optical alignment certificate.

title: Hostel 7 washing machines malfunctioning and tearing clothes
description: Machine #2 and #3 in the laundry room have rusty drum seals that snagged t-shirts and bedsheets. Coin dispenser frequently eats student tokens without starting.

timeline.note: Grievance filed with photographic token evidence.
Laundry vendor summoned to service drum linings and digital tokens.

title: Unsanitary restrooms on 4th floor Lecture Hall Complex (LHC)
description: Taps are continuously dripping and flush valves are stuck. Stagnant water on tiles poses slip hazard and unbearable odor permeates classrooms 401 and 402.

timeline.note: Complaint flagged under public health & campus sanitation standard.

title: Suggestion for vegetarian healthy breakfast options in South Canteen
description: Current options are heavy on oily fried food. Can we introduce fresh fruits, boiled sprouts, oatmeal or multigrain sandwiches for athletes and fitness enthusiasts?

timeline.note: Constructive dietary recommendation received.
Dietitian reviewed proposal and added sprout bowls to morning counter.
Healthy breakfast corner inaugurated with student discount.

title: Severe clash in Elective Subject final exam schedule
description: Artificial Intelligence (CS-412) and Cloud Computing (CS-418) are both slated for November 18 from 10 AM to 1 PM. Around 40 dual-elective students are affected.

timeline.note: Exam scheduling conflict logged by class representative.
Academic committee drafting revised timetable for slot CS-418.

title: Non-functional air conditioning in VLSI Design Lab
description: Workstations overheat and shut down after 20 minutes of CAD tool simulation. Ambient temperature inside Lab 301 is reaching 36°C, making afternoon sessions unbearable.

timeline.note: HVAC technician notification queued automatically.

title: Overcrowding and reckless speeding on North Ring road by supply trucks
description: Contractor trucks enter campus via Gate 2 at excessive speeds during class changeover hours (11:50 AM to 12:10 PM). Multiple near-misses with pedestrians and cyclists.

timeline.note: Critical pedestrian hazard flagged.
Security speed bumps installed; heavy vehicle curfew introduced during peak bell hours.

title: Request for accessible ramp and automatic doors at Main Auditorium
description: Wheelchair-bound students currently require manual assistance up four steep concrete steps to enter the auditorium for convocation and guest seminars.

timeline.note: Accessibility audit request filed.
Civil engineering team measured slope requirements for ADA compliance.
Standard gradient concrete ramp with stainless handrails and tactile paving completed.

title: Delays in refund of caution deposit for graduated M.Tech cohort
description: No dues clearance was completed 45 days ago, but the accounts section has not disbursed the caution deposit refund to student bank accounts.

timeline.note: Disbursement query filed with batch clearance receipt.
Bank NEFT processing initiated for 84 student accounts.
All refunds credited; transaction UTR numbers sent via SMS/portal.

title: Cockroach infestation spotted in Mess 3 vegetable cold store
description: During kitchen walkthrough for student mess audit, multiple roaches were seen around potato sacks and dairy shelves. Immediate pest control required.

timeline.note: Emergency health advisory raised.
Mess kitchen temporarily closed; deep sanitization & fumigation executed.
Health clearance certificate obtained; food-grade airtight containers installed.

title: Badminton court wooden flooring warped and leaking net tension
description: The indoor sports court floor planks near the baseline have buckled due to humidity. Two players tripped this weekend during inter-hostel trials.

timeline.note: Sports facility hazard notification.
Specialist wooden floor restoration agency contracted.
Sanding, re-planking and anti-slip polyurethane coating finished.
